3639-diary-of-a-pedestrian-in-cashmere-a.description: A book by Captain Knight, Forty-eighth Regiment.. the latter head, acknowledgment is principally due to an able and interesting essay on the architecture of Cashmere, by Capt. Cunningham, and also to a paper by M. Klaproth, both of whom appear to have treated more fully than any other writers the subjects to which they refer.

arxiv-1910-12777.title: Noise in stimulated Raman scattering measurement: From basics to practice.
arxiv-1910-12777.creator: X. Audier, S. Heuke, P. Volz, I. Rimke, H. Rigneault
arxiv-1910-12777.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by X. Audier, S. Heuke, P. Volz, I. Rimke, H. Rigneault. We revisit laser intensity noise in the context of stimulated Raman scattering (SRS), which has recently proved to be a key technique to provide label free images of chemical bonds in biological and medical samples.

arxiv-2111-04608.title: Variance asymptotics and central limit theory for geometric functionals of Poisson cylinder processes
arxiv-2111-04608.creator: Carina Betken, Matthias Schulte, Christoph Thäle
arxiv-2111-04608.description: Abstract This paper deals with the union set of a stationary Poisson process of cylinders in ℝ n \mathbb{R}^{n} having an ( n − m ) (n-m) -dimensional base and an m m -dimensional direction space, where m ∈ { 0 , 1 , … , n − 1 } m\in\{0,1,\ldots,n-1\} and n ≥ 2 n\geq 2 .

arxiv-2112-07651.title: Quantum computing for lattice supersymmetry
arxiv-2112-07651.creator: David Schaich
arxiv-2112-07651.description: Abstract Quantum computing promises the possibility of studying the real-time dynamics of non-perturbative quantum field theories while avoiding the sign problem that obstructs conventional lattice approaches. Current and near-future quantum devices are severely limited by noise, making investigations of simple low-dimensional lattice systems ideal testbeds for algorithm development.

arxiv-2210-11561.title: Low-Rank Representations Towards Classification Problem of Complex Networks
arxiv-2210-11561.creator: Murat Çelik, Ali Baran Taşdemir, Lale Özkahya
arxiv-2210-11561.description: Abstract . Complex networks representing social interactions, brain activities, molecular structures have been studied widely to be able to understand and predict their characteristics as graphs. Models and algorithms for these networks are used in real-life applications, such as search engines, and recommender systems.

arxiv-2303-16910.title: Strain correlation functions in isotropic elastic bodies: Large wavelength limit for two-dimensional systems
arxiv-2303-16910.creator: J.P. Wittmer, A.N. Semenov, J. Baschnagel
arxiv-2303-16910.description: Abstract Strain correlation functions in two-dimensional isotropic elastic bodies are shown both theoretically (using the general structure of isotropic tensor fields) and numerically (using a glass-forming model system) to depend on the coordinates of the field variable (position vector 𝐫 \bf r in real space or wavevector 𝐪 \bf q in reciprocal space) and thus on the direction of the

arxiv-2306-07904.title: Dynamical pattern formation without self-attraction in quorum-sensing active matter: the interplay between nonreciprocity and motility
arxiv-2306-07904.creator: Yu Duan, Jaime Agudo-Canalejo, Ramin Golestanian, Benoît Mahault
arxiv-2306-07904.description: Abstract We study a minimal model involving two species of particles interacting via quorum-sensing rules. Combining simulations of the microscopic model and linear stability analysis of the associated coarse-grained field theory, we identify a mechanism for dynamical pattern formation that does not rely on the standard route of intra-species effective attractive interactions.

arxiv-2311-02392.title: Cross-level distillation and feature denoising for cross-domain few-shot classification
arxiv-2311-02392.creator: Hao ZHENG, Runqi Wang, Jianzhuang Liu, Asako Kanezaki
arxiv-2311-02392.description: Abstract The conventional few-shot classification aims at learning a model on a large labeled base dataset and rapidly adapting to a target dataset that is from the same distribution as the base dataset. However, in practice, the base and the target datasets of few-shot classification are usually from different domains, which is the problem of cross-domain few-shot classification.

arxiv-2402-16031.title: Optimizing Single-Photon Quantum Radar Detection through Partially Postselected Filtering
arxiv-2402-16031.creator: Liangsheng Li, Maoxin Liu, Wen-Long You, Chengjie Zhang, Shengli Zhang, Hongcheng Yin, Zhihe Xiao, Yong Zhu
arxiv-2402-16031.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Liangsheng Li, Maoxin Liu, Wen-Long You, Chengjie Zhang, Shengli Zhang, Hongcheng Yin, Zhihe Xiao, Yong Zhu. In this study, we explore an approach aimed at enhancing the transmission or reflection coefficients of absorbing materials through the utilization of joint measurements of entangled photon states. On the one hand, through the implementation of photon catalysis in the reflected channel, we can effectively modify the state of the transmission channel, leading to a notable improvement in the transmission ratio.

arxiv-2406-03921.title: Knowledge Transfer, Knowledge Gaps, and Knowledge Silos in Citation Networks
arxiv-2406-03921.creator: Eoghan Cunningham, Derek Greene
arxiv-2406-03921.description: Abstract The advancement of science relies on the exchange of ideas across disciplines and the integration of diverse knowledge domains. However, tracking knowledge flows and interdisciplinary integration in rapidly evolving, multidisciplinary fields remains a significant challenge. This work introduces a novel network analysis framework to study the dynamics of knowledge transfer directly from citation data.

arxiv-2410-00635.title: GTC optical/NIR upper limits and NICER X-ray analysis of SGR J1935+2154 for the outburst in 2022 H
arxiv-2410-00635.creator: Yi-Xuan Shao, Ping Zhou, Xiang-Dong Li, Bin-Bin Zhang, Alberto Javier Castro-Tirado, Pei Wang, Di Li, Zeng-Hua Zhang, Zi-Jian Zhang, You-Dong Hu, Shashi B. Pandey
arxiv-2410-00635.description: Abstract The Galactic magnetar SGR J1935+2154 has undergone another outburst since 2022 October 10. We present the results of searching for an optical/NIR counterpart of SGR J1935+2154 before and during this outburst. No counterpart was detected at the magnetar’s position in r ′ {r^{\prime}} and z ′ {z^{\prime}} bands, providing stringent upper limits of r ′ ≳ 28.65 r^{\prime}\gtrsim 28.

arxiv-2410-22284.title: Embedding-based classifiers can detect prompt injection attacks
arxiv-2410-22284.creator: Md. Ahsan Ayub, Subhabrata Majumdar
arxiv-2410-22284.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) are seeing significant adoption in every type of organization due to their exceptional generative capabilities. However, LLMs are found to be vulnerable to various adversarial attacks, particularly prompt injection attacks, which trick them into producing harmful or inappropriate content. Adversaries execute such attacks by crafting malicious prompts to deceive the LLMs.

pmc-11438216.title: A multi-view feature representation for predicting drugs combination synergy based on ensemble and multi-task attention models
pmc-11438216.creator: Samar Monem, Aboul Ella Hassanien, Alaa H Abdel-Hamid
pmc-11438216.description: This paper proposes a novel multi-view ensemble predictor model that is designed to address the challenge of determining synergistic drug combinations by predicting both the synergy score value values and synergy class label of drug combinations with cancer cell lines.

pmc-11495622.title: Visual rigid laryngoscopy versus video laryngoscopy for endotracheal intubation in elderly patients: A randomized controlled trial
pmc-11495622.creator: Lijun Weng, Binmei Yu, Lan Ding, Menglu Shi, Tingjie Wang, Zengqiang Li, Weihuang Qiu, Xianzhong Lin, Bo Lin, Youguang Gao
pmc-11495622.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). ObjectiveTo assess the efficacy and safety of visual rigid laryngoscopy and video laryngoscopy and to provide clinical information for developing a more suitable intubation tool for elderly patients.MethodsIn 75 consecutive elderly patients undergoing elective surgery in a single institution, tracheal intubation was randomly performed by 2 experienced anaesthesiologists using visual rigid laryngoscopy (Group I, n = 38) or video laryngoscopy (Group II, n = 37). The primary outcome was intubation time.

pmc-11583907.title: Oral health manifestations and the perceived quality of life among Saudi children: a cross-sectional study
pmc-11583907.creator: Heba Jafar Sabbagh, Shahad N. Abudawood
pmc-11583907.description: BackgroundThis cross-sectional study addresses scarcity of evidence on oral health issues among Saudi children and their impact on quality of life (OHRQL). We aimed to investigate parental reports of oral health problems in children and their effect on their OHQRL.

pmc-12389834.title: Development and Biological Properties of a New Live Attenuated Mumps Vaccine Strain
pmc-12389834.creator: Xue Song, Xiumei Ren, Yang Song, Shengbao Yang, Kailang Lu, Yan Zhang, Jiankai Liu, Chloé Dimeglio
pmc-12389834.description: Background/Objectives: This study aimed to develop a new attenuated live mumps vaccine strain and determine its biological properties and effectiveness. Methods: Plaque purification and amplification were performed in chicken embryo cells. Candidate live attenuated mumps MuV-365 strain sequencing was performed.

pmc-12619201.title: Changes in knee outcome measures following later-stage exercise interventions implemented ≤ 12 weeks vs. > 12 weeks after total knee arthroplasty: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12619201.creator: Phunsuk Kantha, Roongtiwa Vachalathiti, Jim Richards, Wanlop Kunanusornchai, Nantuchporn Khambunruang, Sarinda Sataman, Komsak Sinsurin
pmc-12619201.description: BackgroundLater-stage exercise interventions refer to rehabilitation exercises implemented after the initial healing phase. Following total knee arthroplasty (TKA), patients generally begin these high-intensity exercises at the 2-month mark. Nevertheless, the duration of these exercise programs varies across studies, and the extent to which later-stage exercises contribute to improvements in the knee outcome measures over time remains unclear.

pmc-12844429.title: Assessment of Eravacycline Antimicrobial Susceptibility in China During the First Year Following Regulatory Approval (2023–2024): A Real-World Study
pmc-12844429.creator: Qiaolian Yi, Yi Li, Menglan Zhou, Ran Jing, Minya Lu, Yingchun Xu
pmc-12844429.description: Eravacycline, a novel fluorocycline antimicrobial, was approved by China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA) in March 2023; however, clinical breakpoints and real-world data on its use in China remain limited. We conducted a retrospective, questionnaire-based analysis of eravacycline use across 21 provinces in China during the first year after NMPA approval (September 2023–September 2024).

pmc-13338808.creator: Kaushik Ghosh, Rachael Zuckerman, Yevgeniy Feyman, E. John Orav, Steven Sheingold
pmc-13338808.description: This cohort study examines differences in health care utilization and spending among Medicare beneficiaries with vs without a COVID-19 diagnosis. Introduction The COVID-19 public health emergency ended in May 2023.1 Challenges remain, however, including monitoring emerging variants and, equally important, identifying and assessing acute and postacute impacts of COVID-19.

pmc-13483920.title: MetaOmixTools: A User-Friendly Web Suite for Meta-analysis of Ranked Features and Functional Enrichment
pmc-13483920.creator: Rubén Grillo-Risco, Maksym Kupchyk Tiurin, Carla Perpiñá-Clérigues, Francisco J. Cordero Felipe, Samuel Lozano Juárez, María Iglesia-Vayá, Francisco García-García
pmc-13483920.description: Highlights •MetaOmixTools is an interactive, web-based platform that streamlines the meta-analysis of ranked feature lists and functional enrichment profiles, including 2 powerful analysis modules: MetaRank and MetaEnrich.•MetaRank generates robust consensus rankings across studies using both weighted (e.g., rank product) and unweighted (e.g., robust rank aggregation) methods.

pmc-13676557.title: Ferroptosis in cancer: molecular mechanisms, tumour microenvironment, therapeutic resistance, and clinical translation
pmc-13676557.creator: Ghisaram Dewasi, Sakshi Jain
pmc-13676557.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Ferroptosis is a distinct form of regulated cell death driven by iron-dependent lipid peroxidation and oxidative membrane damage, and it differs fundamentally from apoptosis, necroptosis, and pyroptosis in its molecular mechanisms and execution pathways. Increasing evidence indicates that ferroptosis plays a pivotal role in cancer biology by regulating tumour initiation, progression, metastasis, therapeutic resistance, and interactions within the tumour microenvironment (TME).

pmc-13682275.title: Associations between professional values and self-actualization among South Korean and Chinese medical students
pmc-13682275.creator: Hyojeong Hwang, Jun-Ki Lee, Qiuyue Fang, Hyo Hyun Yoo
pmc-13682275.description: ObjectivesTo compare professional values endorsed at one South Korean and one Chinese medical school, examine which values were associated with endorsement of self-actualization, and identify latent value classes. MethodsCross-sectional convenience survey of 321 medical students: 211 second- and third-year students at a Korean national university, 110 at a Chinese medical college.
